description: Image Description: The image showcases an elegant, three-tiered tea stand composed of fine porcelain teacups and saucers, arranged vertically on a gold-colored metal frame. Each tier features a teacup and matching saucer, all adorned with delicate floral patterns and intricate gold trim. The topmost cup is a soft pink hue with gold detailing and holds a single pink rose with green leaves, adding a touch of natural beauty. The middle cup is white with a subtle pink and gold floral design
